propositions: In-flight code reviews are interrupted by container restart during auto-deploy, causing fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block the existing backfill recovery mechanism, requiring manual re-triggers.
The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is too short relative to measured review durations (260-911s), causing worker cancellation mid-review and vote corruption.

Retryable transient failures (git fetch hangs, scanner unavailable, review-error, llm-unavailable, gate-disabled) currently cast fail-closed -1 votes, making changes invisible to the backfill reconciler which skips already-voted revisions.
Raising DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s enables in-flight reviews to complete before shutdown (Kubernetes preStop quiesce pattern).

Deferring vote-posting for retryable gap reasons (recording attempt in review_attempts table, emitting REVIEW_RETRY_DEFERRED marker) leaves changes vote-less so the reconciler re-drives them within RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.

Escalating to fail-closed -1 after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3) retries with retries-exhausted note and VOTER_ERROR metric surfaces unrecovered failures without silent-pass or infinite-loop holes.
